More info:
This is part of a bigger project, Project: TRASH, a script hub with lots of games with bad anti cheats, hence the name, "Project: TRASH", for now it's free, but once I make a a script for about 20 games, it will go paid, only for about $5 though, and might go up if I get more games.

I didn't really make the discord nice, but if I get 100 members I'll work on it.

This script runs fine on Solara, but Anti AFK is not supported, but you might be able to find one online that does work.

The auto farm is pretty good and can get you around 100 crystals every few seconds, which may not seem good but can get you a lot over a few hours.

Infinite fuel is recommended to be used at the start.

Every time you reset your character, you will need to bypass anti-cheat again if you want to use speed hacks / fly.

If you have any issues please let me know, or any game I should make a script for.
